title: AI Engineer: Computer Vision, LLMs & ML
required_skills: Python, PyTorch, TensorFlow, JAX, RAG, embeddings, vector databases, computer vision (YOLO, Segment Anything), LangChain, LlamaIndex
description:
Serve as the founding AI engineer tackling problems with no off-the-shelf answers on construction job sites.
Build RAG systems that understand construction terminology and domain-specific language.
Deploy computer vision that detects safety violations from real-world job-site photos taken in poor lighting conditions.
Create AI assistants that answer project-status questions by reasoning across blueprints, contracts, RFIs, and daily photo logs.
Design real-time progress tracking that works reliably even with poor site connectivity.
Qualifications: recent graduate from a top AI program or 2-3+ years building production ML systems; shipped at least one LLM-based application used by real users; experience with RAG, embeddings, and vector databases; strong Python skills plus PyTorch, TensorFlow, or JAX; computer vision experience (YOLO, Segment Anything) is a plus.
company_details: This construction-technology startup builds domain-aware AI tools that make construction sites safer and more efficient, applying computer vision and LLMs to real-world job-site data.
